model: GW3-BAC gateway - V8 VRF indoor unit device
equipment_type: VRF BACnet gateway (V8 indoor unit device)
applies_to: Midea V8 series VRF indoor units connected through the GW3-BAC gateway.
summary: The Midea GW3-BAC gateway serves V8 VRF systems on BACnet IP and creates one virtual BACnet device per indoor unit. Each indoor-unit device has 46 objects: on/off and fault status, mode, fan speed, setpoints (single and auto dual), room temperature, error code, swing, setpoint limits, locks, coil temperatures and EXV opening, plus AO/BO commands for mode, setpoints, fan, swing, limits and locks.
notes: The manual is in Spanish; object names and state texts are kept as printed. The device may report different (for example English) names.

Every VRF unit is its own virtual BACnet device. Device ID = ABCDEFG: ABC = gateway BACnet setting (2-400), D = RS-485 port (0-2), E = refrigerant system (0-7), FG = unit address (indoor 0-63, outdoor 96-99). Example: 192405 = setting 19, port 2, system 4, indoor unit 05.
No units are given in the manual.
The manual describes inputs as read-only and outputs as write-only; no priority array is documented.
AO 1 Ajuste del modo also turns the unit on (239) or off (240). AO 15 is printed as SetLimtUDSwing on its detail page (SetLimitUDSwing in the object list).

source.title: Manual de instalación y del usuario - Pasarela GW3-BAC (Spanish)

integration.summary: Wire the V8 outdoor units' X/Y/E terminals to one of the gateway's RS-485 ports, set the BACnet setting on the gateway web page, then discover one BACnet IP device per indoor unit and use AO 1 for on/off and mode, AO 2 for the setpoint and AO 5 for fan speed.

minimum_points.name: Modo
minimum_points.why: Operating mode (read with BI 3 auto flag)

integration.enable: No enable point; AO 1 Ajuste del modo turns the unit on (239) or off (240).
setup: Gateway default IP 192.168.1.8; configure it on the gateway web page (PC on the same subnet).
Three isolated RS-485 ports (X0Y0E, X1Y1E, X2Y2E), each for up to 8 V8 refrigerant systems; 64 indoor units max.
gotchas: Send commands no faster than every 500 ms; the internal command queue can fill and drop commands.
In auto mode the unit uses AO 3/AO 4 (cool/heat setpoints); in other modes AO 2.
Writing a mode or value the indoor unit does not support gives unpredictable results.
